name: Loaded framing
what: charges the room before you can think
affordance: charges the room before you can think — the frame arrives inside the vocabulary
mechanism: evaluative redescription: every word evokes a frame, and negating a frame activates it (Lakoff); frames shift judgment even about events people watched themselves
benign_reading: Vivid language is not a crime, and naming a wrong plainly ('this was theft') can be precision, not spin. The tell is emotion doing the work an argument should do.
ledger_line: {n} loaded term{s} — emotion added where an argument should be
output_phrasing: this term imports a judgment the sentence never argues for
